conditions.tools: Full DeepDeck default tools including Chrome DevTools MCP; only WebMCP changes.
conditions.efficiency: Same 43 tasks passed in both arms of all five models, with complete usage and known incomplete/unverified steps excluded. Site charts use each model’s own eligible pairs.
conditions.revisionNote: The same 49 task IDs were evaluated. Terra spans corpus revisions around an environment readiness fix; hashes are preserved per model. Do not treat these as one identical-build cross-model experiment.
conditions.stepAccounting: Agent steps count step/start events (including a started step interrupted by timeout). Tool calls count tool/call events, including failed calls. A step may issue multiple calls; neither metric is a UI click count. There is no step limit.
conditions.pricing: Historical three-model estimates retained. Luna uses Standard USD API-equivalent rates; MiMo uses official overseas USD real-time API-equivalent rates, checked 2026-09-23. Incomplete usage retains a recorded cost lower bound; null total never means zero cost.
conditions.limitations: Single attempts across dates/builds. Scorer passes are not exhaustive manual completion checks. MiMo calibration with thinking disabled is excluded.
